normalized.result: Confirmed. I reopened the dialog and this time clicked **Delete permanently**, and both selected bookmarks were removed — the Archive is now empty, showing that "Your archive is empty" message again. So a confirmed batch delete really does clear out exactly the ones I chose, for good. Between this and everything before it, deleting a group behaves just like deleting one: careful placement in the Archive, a clear warning, safe cancel, and a final removal only once I say yes. That completes the bulk-actions area for me.
